MINERAL REFERENCE — COPPER

Irregular copper-bearing mineral seams with subdued warm copper, earthy oxidation and greenish mineral traces restricted to the deposit.

Create only the mineral formations and their immediate contact details as an isolated design reference. The completed mcl_deepslate_deepslate.png texture is supplied separately for final composition and must remain unchanged outside mineral-occupied areas. Do not generate, depict, recolor, illuminate or redesign the host stone. Avoid a full stone-tile rendering; concentrate exclusively on the ore deposits.
